definitions.gloss: robust; strong and healthy; hardy; sturdy
definitions.explanation: Having a strong, healthy body that is resistant to illness and fatigue. Emphasizes physical vitality and toughness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強健|きょうけん}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: My grandfather has a robust body.

examples.japanese: {強健|きょうけん}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I exercise every day to maintain a strong, healthy body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強健|きょうけん}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧ひとつ⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He has a sturdy build and has never even caught a cold.

notes:
Compound of {強|きょう} (strong) + {健|けん} (healthy). A somewhat literary or formal way to describe physical robustness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強健|きょうけん}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧: a robust body
- {強健|きょうけん}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧: a sturdy physique
- ⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{強健|きょうけん}: strong in both mind and body

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Do not confuse with ⟦{強権|きょうけん}→強権：18827_kyouken⟧ (authoritarian power), which has the same pronunciation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頑丈|がんじょう}→頑丈：08639_ganjou⟧: sturdy, solidly built — used for both people and objects
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧: healthy — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧: strong, durable — more colloquial
